text:
Maya: FYI APAC2 subnet carveout (subnet-apac2-3b) is blocking GPU warm pool joins — KMS decrypt failures during node bootstrap. Seen this in 2 AZs. Anyone oncall?
Owen: I'll grab it. Running `prov-check apac2 --since 1h`
SRE-bot: alert create GPU_POOL_PROV_FAILURE apac2 - severity: high - incident: #INC-7231
Liam: logs? paste boot log snippet?
Maya: paste:
```
2026-03-23T12:01:04Z kubelet: secrets: decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: not authorized to decrypt with key arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-2:xxxx:key/abcd
role=infra-gpu-node-role session=sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity
```
Julia: looks like KMS key policy denies principals without `sts:TagSession`/required tags. We tightened role-boundary conditions last week — new subnet nodes might not be getting the expected tag.
Owen: Confirmed node role for subnet-apac2-3b is `infra-gpu-node-role-apac2` — missing managed tag `fleet:warmpool=true`.
Security-bot: auditlog entry: `iam:TaggingDenied` for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789:role/infra-gpu-node-role-apac2 at 2026-03-23T12:00:59Z
Maya: That matches. KMS key policy requires tag `team=platform` in `kms:EncryptionContext`. Our bootstrap uses role tags to synthesize that; no tag -> decrypt denied.
Liam: Quick mitigation: patch bootstrap to set fallback encryption context to `team=platform`? Risky for compliance.
Julia: Safer: tagging the role or ASG instances is faster. Temp firewall/egress allow won't help — this is KMS auth. Suggest we add the tag to role via console for the affected ASG and requeue.
Owen: I'll run a one-off tagging for the failing ASG and trigger lifecycle hook retry.
Maya: Doing it now. Ping when retries pass.
Owen: Retried, nodes joined in apac2-3b, warm pool healthy. Will open follow-up PR to update provisioning IAM docs + alert to detect missing role tags. :thumbsup:
Maya: thx. Follow-up owners: @owen for immediate patch, @julia for IAM policy review, @liam for bootstrap fallback design.
